title: Visita à catedral
grammar: Did you…? e respostas curtas no passado
goal: Faça perguntas com Did you…? e responda com Yes, I did ou No, I didn’t.
reading: Noah visited the old cathedral with his friend Tina.
Noah visitou a catedral antiga com a amiga Tina.
They bought tickets and met a kind priest at the door.
Eles compraram ingressos e encontraram um padre simpático na porta.
The priest showed them a painting of a blue boat.
O padre mostrou a eles uma pintura de um barco azul.
Tina took many photos, but Noah forgot his phone.
Tina tirou muitas fotos, mas Noah esqueceu o celular.
After the visit, they heard the organ and had coffee.
Depois da visita, eles ouviram o órgão e tomaram café.
dialogue: Yes, I did. It was very interesting.
Did you talk to the priest?
Yes, I did. He was friendly and funny.
Conversei. Ele foi simpático e engraçado.
Did Tina take photos of the paintings?
A Tina tirou fotos das pinturas?
Yes, she did, but I didn’t.
Did you buy anything in the shop?
Você comprou alguma coisa na loja?
No, we didn’t. We only had coffee.
pron: Na fala rápida, did you soa como “dijiu”: o d e o y se juntam.
gram: Para perguntar sobre o passado, comece com Did.
